row.config_description: baseline v3 with per-case file, no self-correction

results.question: How many orders are there in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

results.question: How many orders have been delivered?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

results.question: What is the average review score for orders paid by credit card?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_payments p ON r.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card';

results.question: Which product category appears in the most distinct orders? Use the English category name.
results.sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many products have no category assigned?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL;

results.question: How many orders have not yet been delivered to the customer?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'created' OR order_status = 'processing' OR order_status = 'shipped';

results.question: How many reviews have no comment message written?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_message IS NULL;

results.question: How many distinct zip code prefixes appear in the geolocation table?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT geolocation_zip_code_prefix) FROM geolocation

results.question: What is the average latitude and longitude of sellers, using their zip code prefix to look up geolocation coordinates?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(g.geolocation_lat) AS avg_lat, AVG(g.geolocation_lng) AS avg_lng FROM sellers s JOIN geolocation g ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix

results.question: Which customers (by unique id) have placed more than one order?

results.sql: SELECT customer_unique_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1

results.question: What is the total price and total freight value across all order items?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(price) AS total_price, SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight FROM order_items

results.question: How many orders were purchased in January 2018?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-02-01';

results.question: Which seller has the highest total sales (sum of item price)?
results.error:
column s.seller_name does not exist
LINE 1: SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_sa...
                            ^
HINT:  Perhaps you meant to reference the column "s.seller_state".
results.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_name, SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: How many orders have a delivery date recorded that is later than the estimated delivery date, regardless of order status?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

results.question: What is the total revenue (sum of item price) per product category for customers located in the state of SP? Use the English category name.
results.sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

results.question: List all distinct payment types used.
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT payment_type FROM order_payments

results.question: How many orders are there for each order status?
results.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status;

results.question: How many sellers are located in each state?
results.sql: SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(s.seller_id) AS total_sellers FROM sellers s JOIN geolocation g ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_sellers DESC;

results.question: What is the total freight value of orders that were paid by credit card?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight FROM order_items oi JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE op.payment_type = 'credit_card'

results.question: How many customers live in a zip code prefix that appears in the geolocation table?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers WHERE customer_zip_code_prefix IN (SELECT DISTINCT geolocation_zip_code_prefix FROM geolocation)

results.question: How many order items belong to orders that were paid with a voucher?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher')

results.question: What is the average price of items in orders that were paid in more than 5 installments? Round to 2 decimals.
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_item_price FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments WHERE payment_installments > 5)

results.question: What is the total payment value of orders placed by customers in the state of SP?
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment_value
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP';

results.question: How many delivered orders have no delivery date recorded?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL;

results.question: What is the average weight in grams of products that have no category assigned? Round to 2 decimals.
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 2) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

results.question: How many orders have no approval timestamp recorded?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at IS NULL;

results.question: How many distinct customers, by unique id, placed orders that were purchased in 2017?
results.error:

                              ^
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

results.question: Among delivered orders that have a delivery date recorded, what percentage arrived later than the estimated delivery date? Round to 2 decimals.
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_delivery_percentage FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

results.question: Which 5 sellers have the most distinct orders, and how many orders does each have?
results.sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC LIMIT 5
